overview: Weapon accessories (sights, muzzle devices, grips and magazines) modify a weapon's Stability, Accuracy, Range, Reload Efficiency, Bullet Velocity, Zoom Level, Aiming Speed and Mobility. Over 50 exist across 4 main categories. You only need to purchase or find an accessory once — after that you can equip it on any compatible weapon you own, as many times as you like.
mechanicNotice: As of the Jan 21, 2026 accessory rework, every accessory of the same type and rarity now gives identical effects (e.g. every Rare 2x Scope gives the same '2.0x zoom, Accuracy +4%' regardless of which weapon line it dropped for), and the old 3 separate reload stats were merged into one 'Reload Efficiency' stat (a display simplification — actual reload times got faster under the new system, not slower). The same patch removed the separate weapon Calibration feature entirely; already-calibrated weapons kept their stats, but calibration blueprints now activate their bonus automatically during crafting instead of being applied afterward.
howToObtain: Purchase from regional Shop vendors — each Stronghold's vendor (Deadsville, Meyer's Market, Greywater Camp, Tall Grass Inn, Blackfell, etc.) sells a different rotating selection.
Severin VII, the Morphic Shop vendor, always carries the same fixed stock wherever you find them.
Found via general world exploration and loot containers.

types.name: Sights / Optics
types.effect: Improve Zoom Level and Accuracy for aimed shots; higher-magnification optics trade faster target acquisition for effective range.

verification.notes: From the official Jan 13, 2026 dev blog on the accessory rework. These numbers are confirmed official stat patterns for the '2x Scope' and '6x Scope' accessory classes the blog describes — which of this list's named items (e.g. Precision Rifle Scope, Tactical Rifle Scope) corresponds to which magnification class has not been independently confirmed, so treat this as the confirmed shape of the system rather than a per-named-item lookup.

Region-of-acquisition data from a single third-party comprehensive accessory listing, not the official dev blog. That source also labels each item with a 'Fine/Excellent/Legendary' tier; those labels are deliberately NOT reproduced here — this database's confirmed rarity scale for accessories is Rare/Epic/Legendary (per the official dev blog stat patterns above, which show no Standard tier for accessories), and while 'Fine/Excellent/Legendary' may just be that source's own casual wording for the same three tiers, that mapping hasn't been independently confirmed, so only region (and weapon compatibility, where the source gave it) is carried over.

Tactical Rifle Scope.sourceNote: Source page spells this 'Tacticle Rifle Scope', almost certainly a typo for this list's 'Tactical Rifle Scope'.

types.name: Muzzle Devices
types.effect: Suppressors reduce noise (and often recoil) for stealth play; brakes and compensators reduce recoil/muzzle climb (Stability) at the cost of noise; flash hiders reduce visible muzzle flash.

verification.notes: From the official Jan 13, 2026 dev blog. Flash Hider stats attach directly to this list's 'Flash Hider' entry (exact name match); Brake and Suppressor stat patterns are confirmed for those accessory classes generally but this list's specific Brake/Suppressor tier names (Compact/Extended/Large/Light/Small Brake, Basic/Short/Integrated/Osprey Suppressor) have not been individually matched to a specific rarity tier.

Region-of-acquisition data from a single third-party comprehensive accessory listing, not the official dev blog. See the sights type's communityAcquisition note for why this source's 'Fine/Excellent/Legendary' tier labels are not reproduced here.

Basic Suppressor.compatibility: Pistol, Rifle, + a third weapon class the source's text left illegible

types.name: Grips
types.effect: Improve Stability and Accuracy, generally at a small Mobility cost — the Vertical Grip is a common early pick for rifles.

verification.notes: Region-of-acquisition data from a third-party comprehensive accessory listing, cross-checked against a direct wikily.gg item-page fetch for Vertical Grip. See the sights type's communityAcquisition note for why the source's 'Fine/Excellent/Legendary' tier labels are not reproduced here.

Vertical Grip.conflictNote: A direct wikily.gg item-page fetch instead described this item's unlock as a Broken Delta exploration reward ('Broken Delta Northwest Riddle Spot — The Creeper'). The two community sources disagree on region and neither is official, so treat both as unconfirmed rather than picking one as fact.

types.name: Magazines
types.effect: Increase magazine capacity (MAG); 'Extended' variants trade Reload Efficiency for more ammo per mag, while 'Tactical'/'Amended' variants aim for a more balanced capacity/reload trade-off.

verification.notes: Exact stats confirmed by the official Jan 13, 2026 dev blog for these 4 specific named magazines. The other magazine names in this list follow the same Extended/Tactical/Amended pattern (capacity-for-reload trade-off vs. balanced) but their exact numbers were not given in that post.

Region-of-acquisition data from a third-party comprehensive accessory listing, cross-checked against a direct wikily.gg item-page fetch for Tactical SMG Mag (which corroborated the region, see that entry's corroboratedNote). See the sights type's communityAcquisition note for why the source's 'Fine/Excellent/Legendary' tier labels are not reproduced here.
